items.exampleEn: This curry is too spicy for me.
items.exampleZh: 這咖哩對我來說太辣了。

items.exampleEn: This shop does not sell alcoholic drinks.
items.exampleZh: 這家店不賣含酒精的飲料。
花椰菜是我最喜歡的蔬菜。

items.exampleEn: Cucumbers grow well in hot weather.
items.exampleZh: 小黃瓜在炎熱的天氣裡長得很好。

items.exampleEn: The butcher cut the meat into small pieces.
I'm stuffed; I can't eat another bite.
items.exampleZh: 我好飽，一口都吃不下了。
items.glossZh: 吃得很飽的；塞滿餡料的

items.exampleEn: These oranges are sweet and juicy.
She made raspberry jam for her friends.
items.exampleZh: 她為朋友做了覆盆子果醬。

items.sentenceEn: We bought some beef from the butcher near the station.
items.sentenceZh: 我們在車站附近的肉販那裡買了一些牛肉。

items.audioEn: The party has fruit juice and tea. There are no alcoholic drinks, so children are welcome.
items.audioZh: 派對上有果汁和茶，沒有含酒精的飲料，所以歡迎小朋友參加。

items.sentenceEn: The chicken stayed juicy because we cooked it slowly.
items.sentenceZh: 因為我們用慢火煮，雞肉保持多汁。

items.sentenceEn: Would you like some cucumber in your sandwich?
items.sentenceZh: 你的三明治要加一些小黃瓜嗎？

items.stemEn: After eating two pizzas, my brother was too ____ to move.
items.stemZh: 吃了兩個披薩之後，我弟弟撐到動不了。

items.stemEn: Mom asked the ____ for two kilos of beef.
items.stemZh: 媽媽跟肉販要了兩公斤牛肉。

items.passageEn: Last weekend, Nina had a picnic by the lake with the other volunteers from the library. She brought a salad of broccoli and cucumber, and her friend Tom brought a box of juicy raspberries. Tom also bought some sausages from a butcher in town. One volunteer made a very spicy chicken dish, but only two people could eat it. They drank lemonade instead of alcoholic drinks because they had to drive home. By the end of the afternoon, everyone was too stuffed to play games.
items.passageZh: 上週末，Nina 和圖書館的其他志工到湖邊野餐。她帶了花椰菜小黃瓜沙拉，她的朋友 Tom 帶了一盒多汁的覆盆子。Tom 還在鎮上的肉販那裡買了一些香腸。有一位志工做了一道很辣的雞肉料理，但只有兩個人吃得下。他們喝檸檬汁，而不是含酒精的飲料，因為他們得開車回家。到了下午結束時，每個人都撐到沒辦法玩遊戲了。

questions.questionZh: 他們為什麼不喝含酒精的飲料？

items.promptZh: 這碗湯辣到讓我一直喝水。
referenceEn: This soup is so spicy that I keep drinking water.
The soup is so spicy that I have to keep drinking water.
rubricZh: 用 spicy 表示「辣的」（例如 so spicy that…）
「一直喝水」可寫，例如 keep drinking water 等
